title: Pro debater agent — Pydantic AI Agent with side=FOR system prompt (rules + explicit skill list) (Epic 5)
prompt:
Create the Pro debater as a Pydantic AI Agent. System prompt states side=FOR, the rules (<=MAX_WORDS, must rebut the opponent, do not concede merely because the opponent sounds convincing), and EXPLICITLY lists its skills (web_search, build_argument, analyze_opponent_argument) and when to use them. See docs/prds/anti-sycophancy.md.

Follow repo standards: TDD (write the failing test first, then code); max 150 lines per code file (split, don't compress); ruff = 0 violations + mypy clean; no hard-coded values (read from config); every external API call goes through the API gatekeeper (Epic 13); log via the LOG package; keep coverage >= 85%. Read docs/PRD.md and the relevant docs/prds/*.md before starting.

usage.summary: usage to be filled by main loop from harness report

note: First agent of Epic 5 (PRD §5.2). New subpackage packages/core/src/agent_debate/core/agents/ with the prompt text split from the factory (both files well under the 150-line limit): prompts.py = pure prompt builder + named constants (DEBATER_SKILLS tuple = (web_search, build_argument, analyze_opponent_argument); SKILL_USAGE one-line when-to-use per skill; SIDE_LABEL PRO->FOR/CON->AGAINST; SIDE_LINE/RULES_TEMPLATE/SKILLS_HEADER/SKILL_LINE_TEMPLATE), and debater.py = the Agent factory. build_debater_system_prompt(side, *, max_words, skills=DEBATER_SKILLS) -> str states the side (FOR/AGAINST), the rules (answer in <= max_words words; you MUST rebut the opponent; do NOT concede merely because the opponent sounds convincing — anti-sycophancy §2 side-anchoring), and an EXPLICIT named skill list with a when-to-use each. NO hard-coded values: max_words is passed in from Settings (changing it changes the prompt), and every label/rule/skill string is a named constant. create_pro_debater(settings=None, *, model=None) -> pydantic_ai.Agent builds the PRO agent over a side-parameterizable create_debater(side, settings=None, *, model=None) seam that task 5.2 (Con) reuses (a _SIDE_MODEL_ATTR map wires PRO->pro_model / CON->con_model with the per-side->DEBATER_MODEL fallback resolved in Settings). When model is injected it is used as-is; else the side's configured model string is resolved offline via resolve_model. web_search is referenced BY NAME only in the prompt (skill is task 4.1, blocked — NOT imported/attached as a tool); full pydantic-ai tool registration is task 4.5 (not over-built here — deliverable is the AGENT + correct SYSTEM PROMPT). Logs via the LOG package (get_logger('agents'), debater_created event). API gatekeeper (Epic 13): N/A here — the factory only CONSTRUCTS the Agent/model objects offline and makes no external call. Re-exported from agent_debate.core.agents and agent_debate.core. TDD red-first: wrote packages/core/tests/test_pro_debater.py (12 tests), watched it fail (ImportError: cannot import name 'build_debater_system_prompt'), then implemented to green. Tests use a pydantic-ai TestModel (from pydantic_ai.models.test import TestModel) injected via create_pro_debater(model=...) so there is NO network call and NO API key needed; the agent's static system prompt is inspected via agent._system_prompts and asserted to contain 'FOR', the word-limit number, 'rebut', the do-not-concede/'convincing' instruction, and all three skill names; one test sets a dummy ANTHROPIC_API_KEY + PRO_MODEL env to cover the no-injected-model resolve path offline. Gates green locally: uv sync clean; ruff check . = All checks passed; ruff format --check . clean; mypy = no issues in 103 source files; pytest --cov = 395 passed, 100% coverage on the new agents/ modules, 100% total (>=85 required); check_line_limit.py rc=0; secret_scan.py rc=0. docs/PROMPTS.md entry added.
